arcade.title: Arcade Hall
arcade.subtitle: 8 retro arcade machines & original creations playable with keyboard or touch
arcade.cabinetsDesc: 8 cult arcade mini-games built in pure Canvas, calibrated for smooth mobile touch controls and desktop keyboards.
arcade.touchControlsDesc: Zero-delay virtual D-Pad, 1:1 paddle drag, and fluid gesture swipes on smartphones.
arcade.keyboardControlsDesc: Arrow keys, WASD, and spacebar fully supported across all browsers.

instructions.snake: Arrow keys (or WASD). Eat the dots without hitting walls or your tail!
instructions.pong: UP / DOWN arrow keys to move paddle. SPACE to serve the ball.
instructions.breakout: LEFT / RIGHT arrow keys to move paddle. SPACE to launch the ball.
instructions.flappy: SPACE, UP, or Click to flap the owl's wings and clear the columns.
instructions.invaders: LEFT / RIGHT arrow keys to steer. SPACE or Click to disintegrate alien waves.
instructions.run: SPACE or UP to leap over brambles, boulders, and forest chasms.
instructions.tetris: LEFT/RIGHT to slide, UP to rotate tetromino, DOWN to speed up drop.
instructions.vectrex: LEFT/RIGHT to rotate, UP to thrust ship, SPACE to fire, E KEY to escape into Hyperdrive.

timeattack.title: Time Attack Sprint ⚡
timeattack.subtitle: 60 seconds on the clock for each discipline. Chain correct answers, build your combo multiplier, and test your speed across all 8 indie mini-games!
timeattack.ruleTimerDesc: Every run starts at 60 seconds. The session concludes when the timer hits zero.
timeattack.ruleComboDesc: Each correct answer earns 100 pts multiplied by your combo, and adds +3 seconds to the clock.
timeattack.ruleMistakesDesc: Each incorrect answer deducts -5 seconds and instantly resets your combo multiplier.
